remarks: Beautiful three-level townhome in the sought-after Springdale neighborhood, where community vibes and vibrant nightlife come together perfectly. You'll love the convenience of being just minutes from local schools, parks, restaurants, and a variety of shops. Enjoy the amenities of Springhill Terrace, including a community pool, tot lot, and assigned parking for both owners and guests, all amidst beautifully maintained grounds. As you step inside, you'll be welcomed by spacious mudroom as you continue into an open concept living space with tons of natural light. A convenient powder room is also located on this level. The eat-in kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area and opens up to a versatile living room with sliding doors leading to a delightful back patio-ideal for grilling or simply enjoying the outdoors. Upstairs, you'll find three inviting bedrooms, each with generous closet space, and a full bathroom with a tub. The lower level provides extra living space that can be tailored to your needs, whether as a family room, office, or guest quarters. Come see this unit today is it will not last long!!
